name: streamOpen
description: Open a general streaming HTTP request: the request body is sent whole and the response body is pulled with network.streamRead as raw bytes, never parsed by the host — the general form of model.rawStreamOpen, not provider-scoped. Runs under the egress policy unless allowPrivateNetwork (the network service refuses a loopback / private peer before the request is written; the connected IP is re-checked at the head and at every redirect hop, skipped through a proxy; refusal: EGRESS_BLOCKED). Redirects are followed. No response-size cap unless maxResponseBytes is given (the guest's pulls are the backpressure). Resolves with the response head { streamId, status, statusText, finalUrl, headers }. At most 32 open streams per connection; every stream is cancelled when the connection goes away. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Header and query values may carry `{{secret:NAME}}` placeholders for secrets stored with secrets.set; each is substituted host-side only when the request URL's origin is the secret's bound origin (SECRET_ORIGIN_MISMATCH otherwise, SECRET_UNAVAILABLE for a missing one — the request is not sent), and a header a secret went into is dropped on a redirect that leaves that origin.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Absolute http(s) URL, at most 8192 chars, no embedded credentials.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: HTTP method. Default GET; CONNECT / TRACE / TRACK are refused.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Request headers, string -> string. Host, Content-Length, Cookie, Connection and the other hop-by-hop / browser-owned headers are refused (INVALID_ARGS). Values may carry {{secret:NAME}}.

inputs.name: queryParams
inputs.description: Query parameters appended (URL-encoded), string -> string. Values may carry {{secret:NAME}}.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Request body bytes, sent whole; empty for none (and must be empty on GET / HEAD). Content-Type comes from `headers` (default application/octet-stream).

inputs.name: streamId
inputs.description: Caller-chosen id, 8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-], so network.streamCancel can cancel before the head; omitted: the host mints one.

inputs.name: idleTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Abort when no response bytes arrive for this long. Default 90000.

inputs.name: maxResponseBytes
inputs.description: Abort once the response body exceeds this many bytes (RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE). Default: no cap.

inputs.name: allowPrivateNetwork
inputs.description: Opt this request out of the egress policy (a local server a person named). Default false.
